description: Default per-frame B-factor and log-scale curve in physical exposure, RELION's per-frame model w_f(k) = exp(B_f k^2 / 4 + C_f).
interpolation: monotone cubic (PCHIP) through the knots; linear beyond the last knot with the last segment's slope; exposure below 0 is held at 0
gauge: B and log scale are relative to zero exposure; frame weights are normalised at each frequency, so a common offset cancels

datasets: large ribosomal subunit (LSU) of yeast ribosomes in situ, 300 kV
provenance.method: per-frame B and scale measured at refined particle poses, then fitted jointly from frame 2 on as monotone curves in exposure; frames 0-1 are dataset-specific and not fitted
